en: You've already seen this, do you want to skip it?
So, we decided to head out on a four-person adventure.
With Kasumi taking the lead, we first take a bus to the city and then transfer to the high speed rail to get to the beach.
Warm sunlight, salty sea breeze, and joyful laughter... We're going to soak up the fun for as long as we can.
I look around with satisfaction at the setup.
Sun umbrellas, beach chairs, a cooler, and cushions are all in place.
Now, I just have to wait for them.
“But it's really crowded at the beach on the weekends...”
“Yup. Full of energy, just like you.”
“Especially since it's my first time at the beach and my first time wearing a swimsuit...”
“Thankfully, I found time to go shopping with Kasumi.”
“She must have said you look cute, right?”
“I'm not used to this kind of place...”
“So many people... I really want to leave...”
“Yeah... we came here to relax, so maybe we should stay here until we get used to it?”
“There are umbrellas and some shade, so it should help relieve some of the pressure.”
“Yeah... {Me}, you can't leave until I get used to it, okay?”
“The changing rooms are really crowded... but they should be ready soon, right?”
“Uh... no... um... you both look really nice in your swimsuits.”
“Hehe... could it be that you're so mesmerized by us that you can't speak?”
Shit... I manage to suppress it with incredible willpower.
Although I'm wearing three layers today, it would still be embarrassing if they found out...
“It's okay, you can look however you want.”
“After all, we bought these swimsuits just for you.”
“Cute, isn't she? I'm the sexy one ♡”
“You too, why are you spaced out like that?”
“It's just... my heart is racing a bit... maybe it's because it's so hot?”
“Oh dear, that won't do. Come on, let's have something to drink.”
“I think we should rest for a little.”
“Geez... Kasumi is even more dangerous than Shizuko.”
“How come Shizuko hasn't shown up yet?”
“She said she was going to check out the food stalls.”
“But there are so many food stalls, I hope she doesn't get lost.”
“I think I know where it is. I'll go and find her.”
“Come on, let's have some cold water.”
“No, we should be thanking you for putting up with us.”
“Don't say that, I'm having a great time too.”
“It's been a long time since I felt like this.”
“When we first came back here, both of them looked so reluctant.”
“To be honest, it's been a while since I've been this happy too.”
“This is my first time at the beach, thanks for inviting me.”
“Oh dear, we have to make sure you have a great time!”
“But you couldn't help staring at me just a moment ago, isn't that so?”
“Haha... It's okay. Like Ayano said, we dressed like this for you.”
Kasumi suddenly gets close to me and pulls at the top of her swimsuit.
“If we have a chance to be alone, I'll let you have a good look ♡.”
“Don't... don't tease me like that... or else...”
“Heehee... Alright... because it wouldn't be good if you had a reaction right here.”
“But don't go looking around, I'm quite jealous, you know.”
“What are you talking about? I've been smiling the whole time.”
“Hey, I said don't get too close to her.”
“Don't get pissed off. I just wanna talk, that's all.”
Shizuku looks really afraid and is slowly moving behind Ayano.
“Are you friends? Oh... Or are you sisters?”
“Relax... This is perfect. Two of us and two of you. Let's get to know each other.”
“Don't say that. I know a great restaurant around here.”
“Have you looked in a mirror lately?”
“You must be really confident about how you look, trying to pick up chicks like this.”
“Chill out, toots. After all, isn't coming to the beach about having fun?”
“Why don't you have fun with your hand?”
“You're obviously way too good for us.”
“If you don't have any business here, could you please not stand in front of us?”
“Hey, can't you be a bit more polite? Acting all high and mighty?”
“We're just having a nice little chat. No need to make a big fuss about it.”
“I rejected you and you kept talking and touching us. You call that a little chat?”
The guy is staring at Ayano threateningly but Ayano isn't backing down. She's fixed him in her angry gaze.
The guy panics under Ayano's intense stare and looks like he's about to push her with his right hand.
However, just before making contact, something stops him.
“These two are with me. If they've offended you, I can apologize on their behalf, but let's hope we can put an end to this.”
“But if it's you who has offended them, then I'll be the one having a little chat with you.”
A flash of light comes from the side.
It's Shizuko pointing her phone's camera lens at us.
“I've captured plenty of evidence. Not to mention all the people who've witnessed this.”
“How you two were harassing these girls.”
All the onlookers agree with Shizuko and start pointing at the two guys.
“Alright, alright! Let go of my hand!”
“Ugh... Let's just go back, these girls stink anyway.”
“Yeah... we're fine, just a bit startled.”
“Ha... I knew something like this might happen. It's a good thing we came together.”
“These kinds of places always attract some undesirable people.”
“Girls as cute and shy as Shizuku are often their targets.”
“That was pretty risky, you didn't need to fight back like that.”
“It's not a big deal; usually people like that leave when they don't get what they want.”
“I still think it's better to be careful.”
“Yeah, when I saw what was happening, I was so worried something might happen!”
“Oh... Alright, alright I'll be more careful.”
“So, did you really go to buy alcohol?”
“Yeah, on my way back, I saw what was happening with Ayano.”
“I wanted to step in, but since you were already coming, I decided to record it.”
“Hehe, smart move. Nowadays, filming is the best choice.”
“But why did you bring your phone? Isn't that a bit inconvenient?”
“...I was worried about missing work stuff.”
“It's a real hassle if you miss messages from work.”
“Is that what most responsible adults do?”
Shizuku pulls gently on Ayano's clothes. Her head is lowered slightly and her face flushed red.
There's no need to say anything. She's acting shy and embarrassed.
“Hey don't be like that, you're giving me goosebumps...”
“Hey, it's not easy for me to say thank you, don't make this harder for me!”
“You idiot. You're so dumb you have no idea how horny you look! Do you?”
“Hehe, quite right that you should feel shy around your family.”
“It's a good job we all get on well together.”
I underestimated the beach a bit.
Despite everything that happened, Shizuku's mood still picked up as the day went on.
Even Kasumi, Shizuko and Ayano were all busy having fun.
But that's what caused everything to go south.
The destructive power of their swimsuits far exceeds my imagination... it's practically physical.
The feeling of rubbing sunscreen into their naked skin is something I'll never forget.
Three pairs of swimsuits against my measly penis...
All I can do is sit down like an imbecile, because the moment I stand up you can see my bulge.
I keep trying to focus on something else, but the three ladies in front of me keep pulling me back to reality.
I press down on my you know what and head to a quiet corner.
This is a corner of the beach, mostly rocky cliffs and reefs, so there are very few people here.
I find a spot with absolutely no one around and sit facing the sea.
Looking at the beautiful nature should help me cool down... At least that's what I keep telling myself.
“Of course, it's just not that simple...”
The image of those four beautiful ladies keeps floating up in my mind.
“Heyyyyy... What're you doing here all alone?”
“There's no one around. It's so cozy—”
I didn't think we'd get a moment alone together so soon.
“Weren't you just with everyone a moment ago?”
“I saw you walking this way and thought I'd see what you were up to.”
“I was just hoping to get a moment of calm.”
“Is that... why you're sitting like that?”
“I thought you were walking a bit funny, so I followed you.”
“I hope you're not hurt... down there?”
Kasumi suddenly takes hold of my hands and inspects me all over.
“It'd be awkward if you someone saw.”
“And guys all love younger ladies, isn't that right?”
“Hehe, I'm just kidding. God, you're so oblivious sometimes.”
“I-I-I like ladies who are older than me. Like you with this swimsuit, Kasumi—!”
“Um... Well... I guess this is my fault...?”
“Looks like I picked the right swimsuit then.”
“Hey... Look, there's no one around here, do you wanna?”
“Don't you think it's the perfect time?”
“And besides, didn't I tell you not long ago that I was gonna give you something to see next time we're alone...”
I hadn't been sitting long when I saw someone coming along the stone wall from the corner of my eye.
“I saw you walking this way alone and thought I'd see what you were up to.”
Ayano walks right up to me and sits next to me.
“Ah... It's cos', well, I wanted a bit of peace. I felt like there were too many people...”
“Oh... I get a bit nervous when we're alone...”
Something that Ayano confessed to me once.
Honestly, I think that she's really cute, especially how she's been acting lately. I can't help but feel affectionate towards her.
But from where I'm sitting right now, I'm not sure which would be better, to get closer to her... or maintain some distance.
Ayano suddenly stands up and turns around.
“You're supposed to say something nice about my outfit.”
“Just like Kasumi and Shizuku, I put a lot of effort into this.”
“Look, my boobs, my belly and my thighs here—”
When Ayano lifts her leg, she loses her balance and falls down, landing right on top of me.
“Well... Looks like I did one good thing today.”
“Hehe, nothing. I'm just really enjoying you being so coy.”
I relax a little. I lean closer to Ayano and gently rub her head.
Ayano twists her body so that she keeps rubbing into me.
“It's gonna be hard for you to walk around like this.”
“You'll have to let me do something about that ♡”
“So you're gonna have to be real nice to me ♡”
An image of Shizuku's face floats up in my mind.
I'm still kinda worried that what happened this morning is still gonna be bothering her.
“As long as she's not hurt, that's what matters.”
Shizuku jogs right up to me, fixing me in her gaze.
“Why do I feel like you're mad about something?”
“Aren't you having a good time with us all?”
“Cos... Every time we start having fun, you go and rest.”
“And now you're just holed up here alone.”
“Hey, it's not like that at all, you're overthinking it, Shizuku!”
Shizuku suddenly presses into me, pushing my shoulders with her hands.
Shizuku's gaze drifts down my body till she spots it.
“How'd you expect me to hang out when I'm like this. It's so awkward.”
“Do you get like this every time?”
“So you're not leaving cos' you're bored... It's cos' you have to?”
Shizuku loosens her grip and steps back a bit.
“Hmmm... I remember now, you really do have this... problem.”
“I hope it's not a serious problem...”
“Well, it's thanks to this... problem... that you came here alone, right?”
“But look, I never really thanked you properly for this morning.”
“Never mind, you just leave this with me, kay ♡”
Come to think of it, I can't remember if I saw Shizuko just now.
“Don't tell me she snuck off to buy liquor...”
“I couldn't miss you sneaking off like you were up to no good.”
Shizuko sits down right next to me and sighs.
“But I feel kinda tired. A little like I wanna go home.”
“Not used to hanging out with the youngsters?”
“What're you looking at me like that for?”
“What the hell are you talking about—?”
“I'm just talking objectively from a male perspective.”
“My bad. You can keep it on.”
“Make up your mind. How exactly do you want it?”
“Hmph... With a mind like yours, no wonder you had to run off here alone.”
“C'mon, you're hard as hell and you can't hide your hugeness. Awkward and rude!”
“This is just my luck. Seeing you all dressed like this, what dude wouldn't get all horned up?”
“Especially you. I'm gonna need a while to cool off.”
“Hm... Tell me what's on your mind?”
“I might have gone to buy the swimsuits with Ayano and Shizuku, but I'm not as cute as them...”
“And I'm certainly not as cute as Kasumi. I don't feel like I fit in here.”
“Maybe you just need to have a bit more confidence...?”
“No! Do you really think I'm drunk all the time?”
“You're different from the rest of them.”
“You're cuter than Kasumi, more mature than Ayano, and more lively than Shizuku.”
“You've kind of got all of their good qualities rolled into one.”
“Why does that sound like I don't have anything special going for me?”
“The point is, that's how you see it...”
“I see... You really are a scumbag cheapskate...”
“Hey... Let me help you with that.”
“If you don't deal with that you won't be able to do squat today.”
“I don't wanna see you in the news for sexually harassing everyone you come into contact with!”
